name: race-free threaded timing run
command: cat /tmp/tq_gemv_neon.c | ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cat > ~/bonsai2/asm/tq_gemv_neon.c && cd ~/bonsai2/asm && LB=~/bonsai2/llama.cpp/build/bin && gcc -O2 -fopenmp -march=armv8.2-a+dotprod -DTQ_XGEMV_LIB -Dmain=tq_neon_main -c tq_gemv_neon.c -o fwd_neon_mt.o 2>&1 | head -5 && gcc -O2 -fopenmp -o fwd_mt fwd.o fwd_neon_mt.o fwht.S -L$LB -lggml-base -lggml-cpu -Wl,-rpath,$LB -lm 2>&1 | head -5 && echo BUILD_OK && OMP_NUM_THREADS=20 time taskset -c 0-19 ./fwd_mt ../models/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-PTQ1_0.gguf 826 279 2943 15127 321 799 3065 421 4203 303 1754 13 --gen 5 2>&1 | grep -E "^step|real|user" | head -22' 2>&1 | head -25
